name: State-Space Regime Filter
concept: Uses a Kalman filter to estimate hidden market regimes and triggers trades when the filtered price deviates beyond a dynamic confidence band.
instructions: Implement a Kalman filter on the 5‑minute close series to estimate the latent trend and volatility; compute the filter residual and its rolling standard deviation; generate a bull_signal when residual > 2*std and the estimated trend is upward, and a bear_signal when residual < -2*std and trend is downward; apply a session_mask for london_ny and ensure signals fire only on the first bar of a deviation.

name: Fractal Dimension Momentum
concept: Calculates the local fractal dimension of price swings to distinguish high‑dimensional choppy periods from low‑dimensional trending periods.
instructions: For each bar compute the Higuchi fractal dimension on the last 30 closes; define trending when FD < 1.3 and ranging when FD > 1.5; combine with ADX>25 for trend confirmation; trigger bull_signal when trending, close > EMA(34) and FD decreasing, bear_signal when trending, close < EMA(34) and FD increasing; restrict to london_ny session and enforce single‑bar entry.

name: Spectral Density Breakout
concept: Applies a short‑term Fourier transform to detect dominant frequency spikes that precede breakout moves.
instructions: Compute a rolling FFT on the last 64 close values; extract the power of the dominant frequency; calculate its z‑score over 20 periods; generate bull_signal when z‑score > 2 and price breaks above recent high, bear_signal when z‑score < -2 and price breaks below recent low; filter with rvol>1.2 and session_mask('london_ny'); ensure one‑time trigger per breakout.

name: Regime‑Switching Hidden Markov Model
concept: Fits a two‑state HMM to recent returns to label bullish or bearish regimes and trades only in the bullish state with strong momentum.
instructions: Fit a Gaussian HMM on the last 200 return observations; label state 0 as low‑volatility and state 1 as high‑volatility; when the model predicts state 1 and close > EMA(55) and MACD histogram rising, set bull_signal; when state 1 and close < EMA(55) and MACD histogram falling, set bear_signal; apply session_mask('london_ny') and single‑bar entry rule.

name: Multiscale Wavelet Decomposition
concept: Decomposes price into wavelet components to isolate high‑frequency noise and low‑frequency trend for precise entry timing.
instructions: Perform a discrete wavelet transform on the last 128 closes using a Daubechies 4 wavelet; reconstruct the approximation (low‑freq) and detail (high‑freq) series; generate bull_signal when approximation slope > 0 and detail crosses above zero, bear_signal when approximation slope < 0 and detail crosses below zero; require ADX>22 and session_mask('london_ny'); enforce first‑bar trigger.

name: Dynamic Fractal‑Based ATR Scaling
concept: Scales ATR stop distances by the local fractal dimension to adapt to market complexity.
instructions: Calculate fractal dimension over 40 bars; compute ATR(14); set sl_long = close - (1.5 * ATR * (FD/1.5)), sl_short = close + (1.5 * ATR * (FD/1.5)); trigger bull_signal when close > EMA(21) and FD decreasing, bear_signal when close < EMA(21) and FD increasing; filter with rvol>1.3 and session_mask('london_ny'); ensure risk distance >= 2.5.

name: Entropy‑Weighted Liquidity Sweep
concept: Measures Shannon entropy of volume distribution to weight BSL/SSL sweeps for higher conviction.
instructions: Compute volume entropy over the last 30 bars; obtain swing_highs and swing_lows via find_swings; define weighted_bsl = (high > swing_highs) & (close < swing_highs) & (entropy < 0.6); weighted_ssl = (low < swing_lows) & (close > swing_lows) & (entropy < 0.6); generate bull_signal on weighted_ssl first occurrence, bear_signal on weighted_bsl first occurrence; apply session_mask('london_ny') and ADX>20.

name: Adaptive Spectral Risk Parity
concept: Allocates risk based on the spectral density of price volatility, favoring periods with concentrated energy at low frequencies.
instructions: Estimate power spectral density of the last 256 returns; compute low‑frequency energy ratio; when ratio > 0.7 and close > VWAP, set bull_signal; when ratio < 0.3 and close < VWAP, set bear_signal; scale stop loss using ATR * (1 + (1 - ratio)); enforce session_mask('london_ny') and single‑bar entry.

name: Nonlinear State‑Space Momentum
concept: Combines an extended Kalman filter on price and its first derivative to capture nonlinear momentum dynamics.
instructions: Model state vector [price, momentum]; run EKF on 5‑minute closes; derive estimated momentum; bull_signal when momentum > 0 and its derivative > 0, bear_signal when momentum < 0 and derivative < 0; require rvol>1.2 and ADX>22; restrict to london_ny session and fire only on first qualifying bar.

name: Fractal‑Adjusted Order Block
concept: Modifies traditional order block zones by expanding them according to local fractal dimension to capture institutional liquidity pockets.
instructions: Identify bullish order blocks via find_swings; compute FD over 30 bars; expand block upper/lower bounds by (FD-1)*0.5% of price; generate bull_signal when price re‑enters expanded bullish block and close > EMA(34); bear_signal analogously for bearish blocks; filter with rvol>1.3, ADX>20 and session_mask('london_ny'); enforce one‑time entry.

name: Regime‑Weighted Supertrend
concept: Applies supertrend but weights its direction by a regime probability derived from a logistic regression on macro indicators.
instructions: Compute supertrend_line and direction; build a logistic model using daily PDH, PDL, and VIX (mocked as constant) to output bullish probability; multiply supertrend direction by probability > 0.6 to confirm bull_signal, < 0.4 for bear_signal; require rvol>1.2 and session_mask('london_ny'); ensure first‑bar trigger.

name: Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MF‑DFA)
concept: Uses MF‑DFA to quantify long‑range correlations and trade when the Hurst exponent shifts toward persistence.
instructions: Calculate Hurst exponent over rolling window of 100 closes using DFA; bull_signal when H > 0.6 and close > EMA(55); bear_signal when H < 0.4 and close < EMA(55); filter with ADX>22, rvol>1.2 and session_mask('london_ny'); enforce single‑bar entry and risk management as specified.

name: Spectral Cluster Breakout
concept: Clusters recent price windows by spectral similarity and trades when price exits its current cluster.
instructions: Compute PSD for each of the last 10 windows of 30 bars; cluster using k‑means with k=3; assign current bar to a cluster; generate bull_signal when price breaks above the max of its cluster and cluster label indicates upward bias, bear_signal for downward break; require ADX>20, rvol>1.2 and session_mask('london_ny'); fire only on first breakout.

name: Entropy‑Driven Volume Profile
concept: Creates a volume profile weighted by entropy of price moves to locate high‑certainty liquidity zones.
instructions: Bin price into 0.1% buckets over last 200 bars; sum volume per bucket multiplied by exp(-price_entropy) where entropy computed over 20‑bar returns; identify the bucket with maximum weighted volume as high‑certainty zone; bull_signal when price crosses above zone and close > EMA(34); bear_signal when crossing below and close < EMA(34); filter with rvol>1.3 and session_mask('london_ny'); ensure one‑time entry.

name: Dynamic Regime‑Switching ATR Trailing
concept: Adjusts ATR trailing stops based on a Markov-switching model that toggles between high‑volatility and low‑volatility regimes.
instructions: Fit a two‑state Markov‑switching model on recent ATR values; if in high‑volatility state, set ATR multiplier to 2.0, else 1.2; compute chandelier_exit using the dynamic multiplier; generate bull_signal when close > EMA(21) and direction from supertrend is +1, bear_signal when close < EMA(21) and direction -1; require ADX>22, rvol>1.2 and session_mask('london_ny'); enforce first‑bar trigger and risk distance >=2.5.
